prompt: An English village green at night: the pub dark, the church dark, the whole green filled with tents and parked cars people are living in, a ring of adults round a brazier at the foot of a stone war memorial, the only light the fire and a few camping lanterns. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
